modInfo: Welcome to our small, one stoplight town. Remus was once settled further east but after the saw mill closed down, the vast majority of the population (all 400 of us!) moved further west. If we don't work at the Zeprino Food Plant we're lucky to be a stylist or mechanic. Best kept vehicles and hair in the state, if you ask me. We are lucky to host the Taft Magnet School which pulls talent from surrounding communities. For entertainment, you can't beat the selection at the local video store. If you don't want to stay in, well, drive to Louisville.

NOTE: This mod was made by request but it was fun to play through so I decided to make it public. It DOES stitch into the large PZ world, just north east of Rosewood. You can hotwire a car and head north to Riverside or south to the military base.
You may choose to start in Remus; if you do, you will begin in a building north of the downtown.
I am willing to fix major errors, but I am unlikely to make honor any change requests for this particular area since it was made for a specific purpose.
I hope you enjoy exploring this area.
-a variety of middle and lower class homes
